meaning: 通过网络互相写信/发消息
usageNote: 动词短语！日常聊天常用，比'chat online'更强调文字交流，像写信那种感觉～

examples.en: We met once at a conference and have been writing to each other over the internet ever since.
examples.zh: 我们在一次会议上相识，此后一直在网上互通消息。

examples.en: Even though they live in different countries, the pen pals write to each other over the internet every week.
examples.zh: 尽管住在不同国家，这对笔友每周都会在网上互相写信。
